text:
elaine (docs): FYI I opened a PR to tweak wording on data retention for audit logs and to update SDK snippets (Go/TS) to use the new export helper. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345 — would love legal + eng signoff before EOD Wed.

sam (product): quick q — is this just wording or are we changing behavior? Will apps need to migrate?

elaine (docs): wording + docs-only examples. Also added a small migration note for customers moving from `audit_event.v1` -> `audit_event.v2` (field rename + redaction guidance). No infra changes.

maria (legal-ops): I'll review. We should avoid 'permanent delete' phrasing. Suggest: "retention TTL: records are retained for N days; after TTL they are made unrecoverable by our logical retention process." I'll paste a suggested sentence shortly.

kevin (eng): Triage: is there an SDK API change? If snippets change imports (pkg path), we might need a minor version bump.

elaine (docs): snippet changes are copy-only — renamed helper function in our code examples from `ExportAudit` -> `ExportEvents`. In Go/TS snippets; no runtime API change, just wrapper names.

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed — preview: https://deploy-preview-12345--redwood-docs.netlify.app/audit-logs/retention

maria (legal-ops): Suggested sentence: "We retain audit events for X days to meet compliance obligations; after retention expires events are irreversibly removed from customer-accessible stores. For high-sensitivity customers, contact support to discuss extended retention or legal holds." ok to include?

sam (product): that sounds good. Maybe add a line about exports (developers can request JSONL exports during hold window).

elaine (docs): added both lines. Also added migration snippet: 
```json
// example migration shim
{ "audit_event_version":"v2", "subject":"<redacted>", "action":"..." }
```

kevin (eng): FYI we need to update the Go snippet import path: `github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/v1/docs` -> `github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/v1/export`. I can open a quick follow-up PR to align package names if you want.

elaine (docs): please do that, thanks. I'll hold merge until legal OK and kevin's package path PR is merged or we mark as docs-only.

maria (legal-ops): Reviewed. One micro tweak: replace 'irreversibly removed' with 'not retained in customer-accessible stores' — keeps it precise. :thumbsup: 

elaine (docs): done and pushed. Anyone else?

sam (product): LGTM from product.

kevin (eng): I'll have a PR up within 2 hours.

docs-bot: deploy preview updated: https://deploy-preview-12346--redwood-docs.netlify.app/audit-logs/retention

elaine (docs): thanks all — target merge Thu 18:00 PT after kevin and maria final signoff. :party_parrot: 

maria (legal-ops): Approved.

kevin (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/678

elaine (docs): merging after CI green. Thanks!
